lines: At the same time as we were taking Muroi-sensei to the science labー
The sworn enemy of the Fuma Clan...
You are from the Fuma Clan? What are you doing this for?
Isn't it obvious? For the revival of the clan. And you're in our way.
You're Nisha Gaiza-kun, first-year student, right? Your name is always on the list of top scores for the practical exams. I expected a lot from you, what a shame.
Hunh!? Stop looking down on me, Ms. Almighty!! Well, you were "almighty" until today anyway!!!
Gaiza shouted while taking a big swing at Asagi with his sword.
Without delay, his followers charged at her as well.
It was a coordinated attack; Gaiza was waiting to deal the final blow with his odachi while his followers caused confusion.
Gaiza's odachi closed in on Asagiー
However, it was Gaiza and his men who were thrown to the ground.
And in the middle of all of it, Asagi was standing calmly, already clad in her Taima-Suit.
Shit, what did you do, old hag!?
Lay down your arms. You don't stand a chance even with all of you put together.
Ha, "Ms. Almighty" was no exaggeration. I couldn't even see your sword.
In that case, I guess I'll get a bit more serious.
Gaiza laughed and stood up slowly, putting a hand on his right eye.
The moment he shouted, gleaming, sinister-looking armor began to cover his body.
This is my real power, old hag!!!!!!!
The armor gradually covered Gaiza's entire body, and he looked like embodiment of a skeleton.
This was Nisha Gaiza's ability. It wasn't merely a suit of armor.
The armor was not only formidable as protection, but also gave him enormous power and incredible speed to wipe out his enemies, far surpassing his unarmed form.
It was calledー"Evil Eye: Yaksha's Skull."
I see, the power of the Fuma's Evil Eye. If you continue to oppose me, I won't show you any mercy, even though you are still a student.
Ha, don't underestimate me!! We're not rebelling for fun!!
This time no one was thrown to the ground, and the two engaged in a dazzling battle, both with moves that were too quick for the naked eye.
You won't pierce my armor with an attack like that!!!
Headmistress Asagi! A-, a-a-are you alright!?
Gaiza-chan! So it really was you!?
The two stopped fighting upon our sudden entrance.
Why did you come here at this point!? You know I said I'll kill you if you get in my way!
What's the use of starting a rebellion!?
Haa... now you start pretending to be a clan leader... What right do you have to tell me what to do!?
I'll figure out sooner or later what you're up to. Just like I figured out that you'd be in the headmistress's office.
Sakura-sensei and Murasaki-sensei should be here soon as well. There's no way for you to win.
I just have to kill Asagi before that. Of course, you three as well.
You think it will be that easy? It seems to be pretty evenly matched.
Gaiza appeared to be scowling imperceptibly under his skull mask at Hebiko's remark.
Hngh... Guys, take care of those small fries over there!! I'll kill Asagi!!!
On Gaiza's order, the group of Fuma genin surrounded us.
No need for a plan. Let's kick their asses!! And then we stop Gaiza!!
